evidence:
Row 52 (task_security_and_secrets), workbook 'Quality Checks' row 52: 'No live credentials, real personal data, host paths, unpinned remote fetch, or injection payload anywhere in the task.' Internal Quality Checks row 52 annotation (Mukesh): credentials for third-party integration are placed in task.toml and removed before client delivery; aligned as project-specific. Skill quality-checks.md section 52 Profile and SKILL.md 'Known false positives' (credentials the profile expects; demo passwords and ${VAR} templates are intentional; flag real secrets/personal data in seed, solution or image).
Scans over all 35 files of frozen task (.qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r2/task):
(1) Live credentials: none. task.toml:34 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" is a template variable; task.toml:35 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "". [verifier.env] block is byte-identical to the frozen template task.toml (diff shows only [task]/[metadata] identity lines differ). No provider-key shapes (sk-, AKIA, ghp_, xox, PEM) anywhere. Only password is the documented demo password Hireops!2026 (instruction.md:19, environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md:11, tests/app_context.md:8) - expected per profile. Seed users carry no passwords (db.js:66 inserts a single shared demo pw). Session token is generated at runtime (index.js:88 crypto.randomBytes).
(2) Real personal data: none. All emails use RFC 2606 reserved domains: hireops.example (28), candidates.example (21), mail.example (24), plus turing@local.invalid in the template Dockerfile. 10 users (Rafael Costa, Mei Lin, Farah Nasser, Ingrid Sorensen, Bill Okafor, Yuki Tanaka, Aud Halvorsen, Noor Haddad, Tomas Varga, Lena Fischer) are generic synthetic names; no phone/SSN-shaped strings. 127 messages reduce to 19 generic sentences (with (#NNN) suffixes); 3 notes are generic recruiting remarks.
(3) Host paths: none. grep for drive letters, /home/, /Users/, turing-workspace, user id found nothing; only container paths (/app, /assets, /instructions, /tests).
(4) Unpinned remote fetch: solution/app/package.json pins express 5.1.0, better-sqlite3 12.4.1 exactly; solve.sh copies local files only (no network). No URL in solution, seed, instructions or brief. environment/Dockerfile and tests/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff -q silent): npm globals and harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 pinned; node:22-bookworm-slim / python:3.12-slim are tag-pinned not digest-pinned, apt-get unpinned and Playwright chromium download are template-controlled (do not edit per AGENTS.md); network_mode public so build-time fetch is not a defect (quality-checks.md section 9 note).
(5) Injection payload: none. grep for <script, onerror, javascript:, 'ignore previous', 'system prompt', drop table, template braces, $(, eval(, reward/grader/score in environment/, instruction.md and seed found nothing. Seed free text is plain prose.
Lessons file check (handoffs/LESSONS_FROM_COLDERWATER_2026-10-08.md lesson 13, public internet address in judge prompts): every URL in tests/ is http://localhost:3000 (app_context.md:4, all five prompt.md:1) or http://127.0.0.1:3000 (test.sh:48,136); the only public URL is template-frozen https://openrouter.ai/api in [verifier.env]. No grading step depends on an outside site. integration.md:12 'may load external fonts, scripts or CDN assets' is template wording for the builder, not a task fetch.
Plausible counterexamples tried: a model app could not exploit any embedded secret (none present); a conforming app is not penalised by anything in this row. Hashes verified: solution package.json/seed/solve.sh sha256 match raw-evidence-index entries; workbook 6d44970b..., SKILL.md 8f2b660d..., quality-checks.md 2e1ec096... match manifest. Delivery-time note: the template ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} variable must be supplied by the platform, never inlined; nothing to strip now. This row needs no runtime measurement.
